items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: And you know when Elvis did it, he did a great job... See Elvis of course, he’s singing about a little hound dog... he goes, 'No, no, this new guy, Elvis Presley.'

ctx.x: And you know when Elvis did it, he did a great job, but it was a whole different thing. You know, he isn’t singing about the same thing she’s singing about.

I just think it’s so — you know this is a different recording than another one I had because she actually, the music actually gets turned around, the beat. Or she comes in, you know, the 12-bar form gets a little askew, the way she’s singing it. But you know what, it doesn’t matter at all.
